title: Shot list
description: The whole contract between InstagramContent and horror-render-engine. Shot list in, numbered clips out. Keep a copy in both repos and bump `version` together.

story_id.description: Matches the existing naming, e.g. 'HorrorStory42'. Clips land in clips/<story_id>/.

style.description: Applied to every shot so one story looks like one story. Scenes vary and there is no recurring character, so a shared palette and grade is all the continuity needed.

prompt_suffix.description: Appended to every keyframe prompt, e.g. 'desaturated, heavy film grain, 1990s VHS'.

reference_image.description: Optional path to a style reference, relative to the shot list.

start_ms.description: Snapped to an edge-tts WordBoundary timestamp, so cuts land on narration beats rather than arbitrary intervals.

keyframe_prompt.description: The still. Composition, subject, lighting — no motion.

motion_prompt.description: What MOVES, and the whole point of the project: it describes the verb completing over the shot's duration. 'her hand closes around the doorknob', not 'a hand and a doorknob'. A shot whose motion prompt is static reproduces the problem being solved.

narration_span.description: The words spoken over this shot. Diagnostic only — lets a human see whether the visual matches what is being said.
